scope: Isolated AC1018 *T1 cached-primitive export to ASCII DXF and fresh libdxfrw readback. This is bounded model transport evidence only; it does not authorize TABLE output or promote display/native support.

input.source_profile: AC1018; selected TABLE *T1, BLOCK_RECORD 0x9d, BLOCK 0xa6; 15 ordered entities

method: Import the physical source and select its unique *T1 BLOCK and BLOCK_RECORD.

Copy only the selected MTEXT and LINE callbacks into an isolated output block; use generated Layer 0 and Standard text style records to avoid importing Layer 0's unrelated extension-dictionary/XRECORD dependency graph.
Write ASCII DXF through dx_iface and freshly import it through a second dx_iface instance.

Compare entity count, order and kind, common visible layer/color/linetype/lineweight/visibility/transparency fields, LINE endpoints/extrusion/thickness, and MTEXT content/style/placement/height/angle/width/oblique/alignment/spacing/defined-height/background fields. Floating-point geometry is compared with a relative tolerance of 1e-10.
result: PASS: all 15 ordered members matched the selected modeled fields; 7 MTEXT and 8 LINE.

probe.scope_limit: The source-to-DXF modeled-field comparison uses libdxfrw for both parsing and writing. A separate LibreDWG 0.14 dxf2dwg+dwgread JSON path independently agrees on the selected insertion, direction, text, layout and LINE endpoint fields. Generated replacement layer/style records mean the original TABLE entity, complete source resource graph and Layer 0 extension dictionary are not in the isolated output. Neither check establishes native display equivalence, rendering, whole-drawing conversion or output authority.

fixtures: No DWG or DXF fixture was added to the repository; source and generated output remain in /private/tmp.

physical_chain: Layer 0 handle 0x10 points to extension DICTIONARY 0xc7.
DICTIONARY 0xc7 is hard-owned by Layer 0 and contains ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP -> XRECORD 0xc8.
XRECORD 0xc8 is owned by DICTIONARY 0xc7 and has one code-340 handle target, MATERIAL 0x47 (trace identifies it as Global).
source_resource_closure_probe.attempt: A second isolated export copied the source Layer 0, Standard text style, DICTIONARY 0xc7, XRECORD 0xc8, MATERIAL 0x47, and *T1 primitives into dx_data.
source_resource_closure_probe.result: Refused during extension-object graph preflight: XRECORD code 340 target 0x47 was not admitted as an emitted AC1018 MATERIAL record. The writer currently source-qualifies typed DWG MATERIAL extension output for AC1021/AC1024/AC1027, not AC1018. The destination was not independently compared before/after this refusal; the generated-layer/style primitive-only output is a separate earlier run.
source_resource_closure_probe.authority_gap: The supplied ODA v5.4.1 specification has no MATERIAL class-body prescription, and this one ODA-converted physical source is not independent producer/semantic evidence. Preserve strict refusal until an eligible AC1018 MATERIAL profile is evidenced; do not widen admission from the callback alone.
source_resource_closure_probe.scope: This explains why the successful primitive-only round-trip generated replacement Layer 0/style resources. It does not justify dropping the XRECORD, target material, or extension dictionary from a complete source conversion.

independent_peer_readback.path: emitted ASCII DXF -> dxf2dwg --as r2004 -> dwgread -O JSON
independent_peer_readback.result: PASS: 51 ordered fields agree across seven MTEXT and eight LINE records: MTEXT insertion points, WCS x-axis directions, text strings, attachment and flow values; LINE start/end points.
independent_peer_readback.limits: MTEXT group-40/group-41 meaning, width/height/extents, native rendering, the original TABLE entity and full source resource graph were excluded. LibreDWG emitted nonfatal header/handle warnings recorded in the P6 MTEXT peer-compatibility receipt.
